what: [soak-report pipeline sync re-emits duplicates] soak_report.py / soak-book-grade-weekly.yml dedupes its PI-SOAK-* pipeline items only against main, so every run whose result PR has not landed re-emits the same 45 items under new filenames (ids identical). MEASURED 2026-11-01: four stuck result PRs (#22029, #22040, #22061, #22086) each added the same 45; the duplicates were dropped from three by hand before landing. Fix: make the sync skip an id that already exists in the store or in any open automation branch, or make the writer idempotent on id. Not fixed by #22090 (that fixed the document-index failure only).
